title: Microsoft Purview DLP: upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and distinguishes the planned upgrade from today's documented protections. Minor corrections should name the existing browser DLP licensing, complete the control paths and align the governance checklist with its table.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because no requirement specific to this upgrade is published.
claims.quote: With a DLP policy, admins can apply inline data protection to identify, audit, and protect sensitive data in interactions with cloud apps (unmanaged and managed) in Microsoft Edge for Business.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the opening licensing sentence and notes with: 'The Purview service description includes browser inline DLP in Microsoft 365 E5/A5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Information Protection and Governance, and Office 365 E5/A5. No licensing change specific to this upgrade is published at the time of writing (November 2026).' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description#microsoft-purview-data-loss-prevention-dlp-for-cloud-apps-in-the-browser. In the cost rationale, replace 'a licence for this upgrade is not yet published' with 'a licensing change specific to this upgrade is not yet published'. This is an understatement of existing entitlement, not evidence of a new upgrade licence.

The user and the app must both be in scope for all the prerequisite protections for the policy to apply to the user in Edge.

claims.quote: You can change the sign-in frequency by using conditional access session controls to shorten the wait time.

Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Conditional Access Administrator.
Browse to Entra ID > Conditional Access > Policies.
claims.fix: Change the sentence to 'Configuring Conditional Access policies requires at least the Conditional Access Administrator role' and add https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/conditional-access/policy-old-require-mfa-admin#create-a-conditional-access-policy to sources.

claims.claim: Today's managed-app policy data and alerts can be reviewed in Defender XDR investigations.
claims.quote: You can view policy data and alerts in Defender XDR investigations.

claims.claim: The Purview policy wizard is reached through Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise apps and Devices > Custom > Custom policy > Managed cloud apps.
claims.quote:
Select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy.
Select Enterprise apps and Devices.
Select Custom from the Categories list and then Custom policy from the Regulations list.
Accept the default Full directory on the Assign admin units page.
Select Managed cloud apps
claims.fix: The printed steps are correct but stop before the app/user scope controls and omit a wizard page. Use 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise apps and Devices > Custom > Custom policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Managed cloud apps' as the common path. State in the note: 'Select Specific users and groups > + Include > Include groups to choose groups; select + Include managed apps to choose apps. Groups must first be imported from connected apps.' The cited setup page documents these steps.

claims.claim: Edge browser enforcement is configured at Microsoft Defender portal > System > Settings > Cloud apps > Conditional Access App Control > Edge for Business protection.
claims.quote: go to System > Settings > Cloud apps > Conditional Access App Control section > Edge for Business protection.
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct page but stops before the deciding control. Extend it to 'System > Settings > Cloud apps > Conditional Access App Control > Edge for Business protection > Enforce usage of Edge for Business > Allow access only from Edge'. In the note specify 'Turn on Edge for Business browser protection must be On; set Enforce for which devices? to All devices for the managed-app DLP setup.'
